card.name: Mid-citation words in reference lists
card.fires_on: Partway through author names, titles and numbers in reference lists and study citations, especially on alcohol and breast cancer. Also on a space before a number like 1 or 83.

modes.label: Author names and titles
modes.description: Inside a split author surname or the next word in a cited paper title.
modes.example: H.<< Kre>>ider, K. McCartney, Family Educational

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space token right before a figure in an age range or drink amount.
modes.example: aged 45 to<< >>83 enrolled in the Swedish Mamm

modes.label: Linking word in a citation title
modes.description: A comma, of, or adjective inside a cited title on alcohol, cancer or abuse.
modes.example: Alcohol<<,>> tobacco and breast cancer – collaborative reanalysis

card.plain: It fires on odd spots inside citations, such as split surnames and the space before a number.
